about: The epistola of the formulary “Most Holy Name of Jesus” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: In those days Peter, filled with the Holy Ghost, said: Ye rulers of the people and elders, hear. If we this day are examined concerning the good deed done to an infirm man and by what means he hath been made whole, be it known unto you all and unto all the people of Israel that in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ of Nazareth, Whom ye crucified and Whom God raised from the dead, even by Him this man standeth here before you whole. This is the stone rejected by you the builders, which is become the head of the corner. Neither is there salvation in any other; for there is no other name under heaven given to men whereby we must be saved.
